title: Transmission Log 5024u-04-11
body: [Blackbeard] Ariel. I have been informed that Union will be conducting a large scale operation on Gemma.  No doubt influenced by the IPS-N dogs.  [Ariel] How large scale are we talking?  [Blackbeard] Unsure of the exact numbers, but from my understanding the whole damn planet will be swarming with Lancers.  [Ariel] We must free Alfven Alto before the outsiders get their hands on it then.  [Blackbeard] Already too late. That bitch Phoenix from the Enforcers squad has already landed and is tasked with the defense of the city.  [Ariel] I will defeat her, lord Blackbeard  [Blackbeard]  You will not. Count yourself lucky she's been tasked with the defense of the city. I'm unsure how much IPS-N knows about the city, but if she's in charge of security they do NOT want it to fall.  [Ariel] ... But the city must be rec-  [Blackbeard] SILENCE YOU BATTLE FREAK! I don't care what you say, we're not fucking fighting her. Here are your new orders : focus the anti-air cannon on IPS-N mining equipment.  [Ariel] We'll be detected.  [Blackbeard] I've already tasked the raiders under Crusher with ensuring the Union communication array is disrupted. So long as you keep the Anti-orbital surveillance camouflage up, you should not get detected.  [Ariel] ...Understood.  (END OF TRANSMISSION)

title: Transmission Log 5024u-04-20
body: [Blackbeard] Ariel. The raiders took out some Jewelers earlier today. It seemed they had Union operation plans on them, including information on an operation to restore communications accross Gemma, beginning with the radio tower at Latitude: 58.19799, Longitude: -25.92014 I've tasked Crusher with making sure it doesn't happen.  [Ariel] Understood, lord Blackbeard. Do you want me to assist them? [Blackbeard]  No. I have another reason for contacting you. a IPS-N vip is set to land in a few days on the planet. we have reasons to believe half of the key to the Alfven throne will be on the ship. Do not take it down, else we risk losing it to the sands. You are free to shoot down the rest of the ships that will be escorting her. We have our hands full with the Lancers, we don't need the IPS-N elite landing.  [Ariel] Understood. I will  (END OF TRANSMISSION)

title: Transmission Log 5024u-04-25
body: [Blackbeard] Ariel. It seems Crusher failed. The Alfven Alto communication network has been reestablished.  [Ariel] Shall I go destroy it?  [Blackbeard] Its pointless now. They'll be able to detect you in the Landship. Path towards the north and return to HQ. Make sure to hide in the caverns as much as possible during the day.  [Ariel] This is cowardly behavior. Musashi will not stand for it.  [Blackbeard] I don't give a rat's ass about your NHP. Two other landships have already been taken out, one got assaulted by Royal Flush and the other one ambushed by some covert squad. We cannot afford to lose your ship or we will lose all Anti-Air capabilities. Do NOT contact me until you've arrived to HQ. (END OF TRANSMISSION)

title: Transmission Log 5024u-04-28
body: [Ariel] *Loud explosions can be heard in the background* Lord Blackbeard, we have been compromised by Lancers. I will dispatch them and keep heading towards HQ. (NO RESPONSE)
